title: File:Wedding dress from 1995 film Sense and Sensibility.jpg
desc:
Wedding dress worn by Kate Winslet in the 1995 film Sense and Sensibility. The film received BAFTA and Academy Award nominations for Best Costume Design.
Displayed at "A Celebration of Bridal Gowns" exhibition in Ely Cathedral, 2024. On loan from Cosprop.
